title: When a question and its text disagree
statement: When a question and its text disagree, it is not settled which should change: one rule edits the passage for a vocabulary item, another bars editing it for a quotation.
detail: The course-fix procedure repairs a vocabulary item whose word is not in the passage by editing the passage to use the word in context, never by rewording the stem or deleting the item (`grade3-reading/knowledge_bot/skills/timeback-course-fix/SKILL.md`). The content-integrity check says never to repair a missing quotation by changing the passage unless the passage's own authority is wrong (`grade3-reading/knowledge_bot/handoffs/g3-reading-v2-feedback-2026-07-16/tooling/ti-courseplans-2169d1f/skills/course-content-integrity/SKILL.md`). The second rule's exception, a passage that is itself wrong, may reconcile the two, but no ruling was found that says so.
against: No ruling reconciling the two rules was found.

evidence.quote: Never repair a missing quote by changing the passage unless the passage authority itself is wrong.
**Vocab word-not-in-passage (NN#5):** FIX by editing the PASSAGE — `PUT {QTI}/stimuli/{id}` to use the word in context. Never reword the stem to dodge it; never delete the item.
